## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `377ca896d63c319ba1a22d6c484be0268c69ac6f` · 2026-11-26T03:25Z

PR #37383 (`Fixes #36909`), dev report 7179500392, merge addendum 7180856694, head finalized by the zone at 2026-11-26T02:41Z (7181041223). Read against GitHub and a throwaway worktree at head, not against the report.

The redirect table is right and well pinned: every retired pillar address lands on a live page in one hop, its query and deep-link meaning kept, and 9 of my 11 ablations go red. Three should-fix items stand between it and a landing. All three are small and sit in files the PR already touches.

- **Landing:** not yet. It is Tier S once accepted: not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 37383`: 0 of 68 paths) and 1,976 changed lines, under 3,000. K = 6, below 15, no main commit touches its files, and `merge-tree` is clean, so it needs no main merge for the rework round. Back to the dev for S1–S3; the re-review is a delta read of those three.

### Should-fix

- **S1 — `studioSamePageSearch` is left with no reader.** This PR removed its one production reader, the pillar re-entry effect in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (base `a89a0123`, line 1310). At head it is still exported (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioPaletteModel.ts:177-180`), and only its own test case reads it (`studioPaletteModel-36900.test.ts:222-225`, "the re-entry's query matches the router's…", which pins the retired remount). I swept every export in the PR's touched source files for a non-test reader: this is the only one that went from 1 at base to 0 at head. The card's item 5 removes "不再被引用的分区外壳代码和测试", and this seat's carry 7157423170 set the bar: "A hook nobody reads should not stay." Fix: delete the function, its import at `studioPaletteModel-36900.test.ts:29` and that `it` block.
- **S2 — The changeset says something false about the toast.** `.changeset/36909-studio-pillar-addresses.md:19` says: "The "Open Access" button on a publish toast and the Changes sheet's link to a permission set open the set's page directly." The toast names no set. It opens the package's permission set list: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:911` → `/studio/<package>/metadata/permission?package=<package>`, and the pin at `StudioDesignSurface.publishCount-11807.test.tsx:340` expects exactly that. The sentence ships in `@object-ui/console`'s published CHANGELOG. The PR body's §2 (line 32) says the same. Fix: e.g. "The "Open Access" button on a publish toast opens the package's permission sets, and the Changes sheet's link to a permission set opens that set's page, directly."
- **S3 — The Changes sheet's new permission-set navigation has no pin.** `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:1197` widens `requestSurface` from `object` to `object || permission`, which is the second half of the changeset sentence above. Ablation A11 narrows it back to `object` alone, and nothing goes red: the 50 touched test files stay green (438 tests). Over the whole studio-design and preview suites (332 files, 2,600 tests) the one red was `heldFlowLeave-26705`'s menu-departure case at 4.4 s under load. It is unrelated: that file goes 12/12 green alone with the mutation still in place, and 12/12 twice at head. The object branch is pinned next door, in `StudioDesignSurface.heldDataCreate-26845.test.tsx` (a stand-in sheet asks the host for an object) and the flow branch in `heldFlowCreate-26845`. Fix: one case of the same shape for `{ type: 'permission', name }`, asserting `/studio/<draftScope>/metadata/permission/<name>` on a writable base and on a read-only base with a pair.

### Checklist

- **Shape (`l1-face.mjs --pr 37383`).** CLEAN, 13 items read, none flagged.
  - Open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #36909`.
  - No closing keyword binds any other card, and none is in the body read by eye.
  - One changeset covers the published package touched, `@object-ui/console`. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`.
  - No release-notes path, no `+0/-0` file, dogfood not owed.
  - 13 skips, all expected.
- **Redirects, address by address.** These were read in `studioPillarRedirectModel.ts`, `StudioPillarRedirect.tsx` and `StudioRoute.tsx:308-325`, and cross-checked against `studioAddressTable.ts` and `studioAddress.ts` at head.

  | Retired address | Lands on (at head) | Kept | Before |
  |:--|:--|:--|:--|
  | `/studio/P` (bare) | `/studio/P/metadata/object?package=P` | query (the old `<Navigate to="data">` dropped it) | 3 hops |
  | `/studio/P/data[?surface=object:N]` | the object list, or `/metadata/object/N?package=P` | `?action=`, `?changes=review`; `?view=` and `?nav=` dropped (as #36904) | 2 hops |
  | `/studio/P/automations[?surface=flow:N]` | the flow list, or `/metadata/flow/N?package=P` | other params; `view` and `nav` dropped (as #36903) | 2 hops |
  | `/studio/P/access[?surface=…]` | `AccessPillarLanding` → the set list, the set (holder read), or `/owd` | other params | through the surface |
  | `/studio/P/interfaces[?…]` | the object list, plus the retired notice state | `STUDIO_RETIRED_INTERFACES_KEPT_PARAMS` only | 3 hops |
  | `/studio/~org` and `/studio/~org/<x>` | `/studio/~org/metadata/flow[/N]?source=runtime` | `~org/automations` keeps the flow; the rest drop the query, as the base surface's fallback did (base `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:1640`) | 2 hops |

  - The `.custom` pair rules match base. Data and Automations ran before the base's `pairBase` check, so they land in the pair's own area. Interfaces and Access landed on the base.
  - `owd`, unknown segments, `~all` and an empty segment return `null`, so the route draws the builder. The pair→base redirect for those is kept (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx:238`).
  - Router state rides along (`target.state ?? location.state`), the same as base's `landingState`.
  - The redirect sits inside `StudioRoute`'s gate (child of the `/studio` element), so no ungated path opens.
  - `settledAreaAddress` applies `areaLocationRedirect` once. The pin `every target in the table, and every Access target, is where the area would put it` holds that each target settles to itself.
- **Item types.** Every row of `STUDIO_ITEM_TYPES` now carries a required `redirectsTo`. `studioAddress.test.ts` holds each row equal to the table for every spelling, and ablations A1 and A2 turn it red.
- **`studio.app.ts` (card item 4).** I read it; I did not run the dev's scratch walk. All 15 `metadata:resource` / `metadata:directory` entries pass `params.package: '{active_package}'`. `setupMetadataStudioPath` → `areaLocationRedirect('~all', TYPE, '?package=P')` → `/studio/P/metadata/TYPE?package=P`, which is settled because `package === segment`. None of them is a pillar address, so no change is owed.
- **Dead code, `git grep` at head.** These have 0 readers anywhere outside `*.md`: `AREA_PILLAR_FOR_TYPE`, `studioItemPillar`, `studioPillarItemAddress`, `studioSurfaceQuery`, `STUDIO_ORG_SCOPE_PILLAR`, `useSurfaceDeepLinkCapture`, `useSurfaceDeepLinkMirror`, `parseSurfaceTarget`, `resolveSurfaceDeepLink`, `PILLAR_FOR_SURFACE_TYPE`, `PILLAR_TYPE` and `pillarEntry`.
  - The remaining hits are prose or unrelated. `areaItemPillarPath` and `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR` appear only in comments (N2) and in historical `docs/qa` change notes. `useRequestedSurface` appears only in two comments that record its removal. `SurfaceRequest*` is the kept `SurfaceRequestHandler` type. `PILLARS` is a test-local const in `readOnlyPosture-12453`.
  - `pillarEntry` was write-only at base (declared at base `:1297` and never read), as the body says.
  - The one export this PR orphans is S1.
- **i18n.** The diff touches no file under `ui/packages/i18n` and removes no `'engine.…'` call site.
  - `check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` reports the same 536 candidates (123 confirmed) on the base and head trees. Its candidate lists are byte-identical; only the walked-file count differs, 2454 → 2456.
  - `released-keys-removed.mjs --tag @object-ui/i18n@18.6.0 --json` (18.6.0 is the newest tag) gives the same 80-key `groups` at `--ref` base and head.
  - `engine.studio.pillar.*` has 0 keys at base, so card item 3 was already done, as the claim's Premise says.
- **Tests.**
  - The removed cases cover only removed code: `studioSurfaceQuery`, `studioPillarItemAddress`, the `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR` agreement checks, `resolveSurfaceDeepLink`, `parseSurfaceTarget`, the mount-time capture, and the channel's subscriber half (delivery, request stamping, veto publishing nothing).
  - The kept qualifier keys and `useSurfaceActionDeepLink` still have readers.
  - In 38 surface tests the only change is the `StudioPillarRedirect` wrapper (2–5 lines each).
  - `ui/e2e` and `packages/qa` name no retired address and mount no bare surface on `:tab`.
  - `docs/qa` still names `/data`, `/automations`, `/access` and `/interfaces` addresses in 47 places. All of them predate this PR and still land through the redirect (N4).
- **Declarations.** `readClause2Line` and `readMetadataProtocolLine` (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` at head) were run on three texts: the newest `Claim:` on #36909 (7175606427), the PR body and the changeset. All three read `declared · no · arm null` and `declared · none`, so they match. `Clause-②: no` holds: app-shell is private and its removed exports were never published past 18.2.0. `patch` matches `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Pins at head.** In the worktree, the dev's pins (`studioPillarRedirectModel.test.ts` and `StudioRoute.metadataArea-28561.test.tsx`) give `Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 64 passed (64)`, the dev's count. All 50 touched test files give `Test Files 50 passed (50) · Tests 438 passed (438)`.
- **Ablations.** I wrote 11 of my own, separate from the dev's three, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. Every anchor hit x1, every mutation landed (blob changed), and every restore read `blob == HEAD` with an empty `git diff HEAD`. `git diff --stat HEAD` was empty after the run.

  | Ablation | Red |
  |:--|:--|
  | A1: the `automations` row removed from the table | 9 of 148: every Automations row, pure and route-level, plus the `redirectsTo` agreement and the coverage pin |
  | A2: the Data case drops its query | 9 of 148: every `?surface=`, `?changes=review` and `?package=` row on `/data` |
  | A3: the route element hands the table no query | 4 of 148: the route-level query rows, `~org` included |
  | A4: bare `:packageId` back to the pre-PR `<Navigate to={STUDIO_HOME_PILLAR}>` (as `"data"`) | 1 of 60: `/studio/P … in one redirect` |
  | A5: `~org` back to the pre-PR `<Navigate to={STUDIO_ORG_SCOPE_PILLAR}>` (as `"automations"`) | 1 of 60: `/studio/~org … in one redirect` |
  | A6: the Interfaces target not settled | 10 of 148 |
  | A7: a pair's Interfaces lands on the pair, not the base | 2 of 148: pure and route-level |
  | A8: the `~org` catch-all dropped | 3 of 148: `~org/access`, `/interfaces`, `/owd` |
  | A9: the Interfaces notice state not written | 6 of 68: the whole `interfacesRetired-36502` file |
  | A10: the toast's "Open Access" target not settled | **none** (11 of 11 green): the pin reads the final location, which the area settles anyway (N3) |
  | A11: the Changes sheet's permission request narrowed back to objects | **none**: 50 touched files / 438 tests green. Over studio-design and preview, 1 of 2,600 red, a load flake (`heldFlowLeave-26705`, 12/12 green alone under the mutation) (S3) |
- **Check-runs at head (REST).** 51 runs: 38 `success`, 13 `skipped`, 0 failed, 0 pending, and no commit status.
  - These are all `success`: Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Test UI and its 9 shards, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, and Type Check · debt ledger.
  - The skips are matrix placeholders, opt-in jobs and queue-only jobs, and `l1-face` reads all 13 as expected.
- **Merge-tree and K.** `git merge-tree --write-tree` against origin/main `ecbe854bda8559069fb228eed1a1564000d2f259` exits 0 (clean, tree `ffa03271`). K = 6, against the zone's 3 at finalize. None of the 6 touches any of the 68 files, and none adds a `/studio/` literal or a bare surface mount.
- **Governed / tier.** `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 37383` exits 0. It reports "0 of 68 path(s) hit the register", NOT governed, and 1,976 changed lines, at most 3,000. That is Tier S.
- **维护者速读.** It is accurate against the diff: old addresses still open, in one hop; the cleanup is invisible to users; a missed address would land on not-found; it is front-end only and reverts cleanly; 「要你做什么：无」.

### Notes

- N1 — Card item 1 says to delete the `:packageId/:tab` route. The PR keeps it but changes what it does: it now renders `StudioPillarRedirect` around the builder (`StudioRoute.tsx:318-325`), because `owd` and the not-found state still answer on it. No pillar page is reachable from it, and every retired segment redirects (A1–A9). I read this as meeting the item's intent, with the Done-when ("所有旧分区地址仍重定向到新地址") met in full.
- N2 — Some comments still name deleted symbols. `studioMenuModel.ts:22-26`, in a file this PR edits, says an item a pillar designs "still opens its pillar … (`areaItemPillarPath`)". `studioAddress.guard.test.ts:6-10` gives `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR` as the guard's rationale. Fold both into the S-round if convenient; neither blocks on its own.
- N3 — The body's "Open Access … without the hop" one-hop half is unpinned (A10 is green). The destination is pinned, and an extra hop there would not be a retired address. This is optional.
- N4 — `docs/qa/platform-checklist` still steps through `/studio/PKG/data`, `/automations`, `/access` and `/interfaces` (47 hits, the oldest from #36903 to #36905). This PR changes none of them, and each still lands through the table. Steps that describe pillar UI ("screenshot the rail settled", "the pillar says…") were stale before this PR. That is a checklist-accuracy sweep, not this card's.
- N5 — `STUDIO_RETIRED_PILLAR_SEGMENTS` is a new export read only by its coverage pin. That is acceptable as the table's declared domain.
- N6 — The body's Verification readings sit on `26ec30e1` / `2322b402`. The addendum 7180856694 re-reads on `377ca896`: both type-checks are 0, and 286 files / 2,317 tests pass. Its only correction is the count, 37 → 38 wrapped surface tests. My own head readings are above.
- N7 — Known and not re-litigated:
  - Q1 A (switching the producers that still write retired addresses, `studioHomePath` callers and `setupMetadataRedirect`'s two-hop legacy bookmarks) is the next round's follow-up.
  - `engine.studio.notFound.pillar` (en and zh) and `StudioAiCopilot`'s `:tab` / `?surface=` context go to the close-out brief.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `1d782fb08103cec7877f718b845df46a313564b1` · 2026-11-26T04:54Z

PR #37383 (`Fixes #36909`), re-review of my REWORK 7181710790 at `377ca896`, against addendum 2 (7182428610). The new head is one commit on top of `377ca896` (parent checked: `1d782fb0`'s only parent is `377ca896d63c319ba1a22d6c484be0268c69ac6f`). I read the delta in full (6 files, +63/-26) and ran it in a throwaway worktree at head, not against the report.

S1, S2 and S3 are closed, and N2 with them. The delta does nothing else. A11 now goes red on exactly the two new cases.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- **Landing:** Tier S, and zone a4-S lands on ACCEPT. It is not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 37383`: 0 of 69 paths) and has 2,063 changed lines, at most 3,000. `merge-tree` against the current origin/main is clean. **K is now 18 (≥ 15)**, against 6 at my last round: main merges first, and the re-run must be green before it is queued (N1).

### Rework items

- **S1 — closed.** `studioSamePageSearch` is deleted from `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioPaletteModel.ts` (was `:177-180`; head `:174` now ends `studioPaletteDeparture`, and the next block is the `openStudioPaletteAddress` docblock). Its import is gone from `studioPaletteModel-36900.test.ts:23-29`, and so is the `it` block ("the re-entry's query matches the router's…", was `:222-225`). `pageQuery` (`studioPaletteModel.ts:150`) keeps its reader, `studioPaletteDeparture` (`:174`). `git grep -c studioSamePageSearch` at head over the whole tree: no match (exit 1). `studioPaletteModel-36900` at head: 14 passed (14).
- **S2 — closed.** The changeset now reads (`.changeset/36909-studio-pillar-addresses.md:19`): "The "Open Access" button on a publish toast opens the package's permission sets, and the Changes sheet's link to a permission set opens that set's page, directly." The live PR body's §2 (line 32) now reads: "The publish toast's "Open Access" now opens the package's permission sets, and the Changes sheet's link to a permission set opens that set's page, directly instead of through the old Access address." Both match the code:
  - the toast: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:911` → `settledAreaAddress(studioMetadataTypePath(scopeSegment, 'permission'))`, pinned at `StudioDesignSurface.publishCount-11807.test.tsx:340` (`/studio/<package>/metadata/permission?package=<package>`);
  - the sheet: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:1197-1198` → `studioItemPath(draftScope, 'permission', name)`, now pinned (S3);
  - "instead of through the old Access address" holds for both. At base `a89a0123`, the toast went to `studioPillarPath(scopeSegment, 'access')` (`:964`), and a permission request fell through to `studioPillarItemAddress` on the Access pillar (`:1279`).
  - The body also changes 37 → 38 wrapped surface tests (the addendum 7180856694's correction, my N6) and adds a Tests bullet for the new pin. Nothing else in it changed: a `diff` against the copy I read last round shows those three hunks only.
- **S3 — closed.** `StudioDesignSurface.heldDataCreate-26845.test.tsx:288-310` adds a describe with two cases. The stand-in sheet now offers `{ type: 'permission', name: 'acme_sales_rep' }` beside the two objects (`:93-97`). Its button names keep the old spelling (`Pending object/<name>`), so the existing three cases are unchanged.
  - The writable base lands on `/studio/PKG/metadata/permission/:name` (`:289-296`). The pair's route must stay empty, and the confirm is never asked.
  - On a read-only base with a pair, it lands on `/studio/PAIR/metadata/permission/:name` (`:298-309`), and the base's route stays empty.
  - The landings are test-local routes declared ahead of the area route (`:203-204`), and a `Landed` marker that prints `:name` (`:178-181`). The case reads the item's name, not just "somewhere under permission".
  - This is the shape I asked for: both legs of `draftScope`. A11 is below.
- **N2 — closed.** `studioMenuModel.ts:23-27` no longer names `areaItemPillarPath`. `studioAddress.guard.test.ts:6-11` no longer gives `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR` as its rationale. `git grep -E "areaItemPillarPath|STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR" -- 'ui/**'` at head: 0. Both rewrites are comment-only and true at head.
- **Nothing else.** `git diff --stat 377ca896..1d782fb0` lists exactly these 6 files: the changeset, the three tests, and the two sources. The only non-comment source change is the S1 deletion. The commit is a fast-forward, with no main merge.

### Checklist

- **Shape (`l1-face.mjs --pr 37383`, read 2026-11-26T04:45Z).** CLEAN, 13 items read, none flagged.
  - Open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #36909`, and no other card bound.
  - One changeset covers `@object-ui/console`.
  - Declarations are `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`. Dogfood is not owed.
  - Its `pr-state` leg read `mergeable_state` as unknown on one read. `pr-state.mjs --pr 37383` re-read it as `clean`, COMPLETE, with no reviews at head and never queued.
- **Tests at head (worktree `wt2`, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, framework closure `turbo build` of `@objectstack/{client,formula,lint,sdui-parser,spec}...`: 44/44, all cache hits).**
  - Delta files plus the two named ones (`StudioDesignSurface.heldDataCreate-26845`, `studioPaletteModel-36900`, `studioAddress.guard`, `StudioDesignSurface.publishCount-11807`): `Test Files 4 passed (4) · Tests 33 passed (33)`. In `heldDataCreate-26845`, 5 passed (5), the two new cases by name.
  - All 51 test files the PR touches at head (50 last round, plus `studioAddress.guard.test.ts`): `Test Files 51 passed (51) · Tests 442 passed (442)`, exit 0.
- **Ablation A11 (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode).** It narrows `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:1197` from `(target.type === 'object' || target.type === 'permission') && draftScope !== null` to `(target.type === 'object') && draftScope !== null`.
  - The anchor hit x1, then x1 → x0. The replacement went x0 → x1. The mutation landed: blob `da3b6c68301c` → `1dda6837f4bb`. (The dev's spelling, without the parentheses, gave `6dadace116bf`; it is the same mutation.)
  - **Red now:** over all 51 touched files, `Test Files 1 failed | 50 passed (51) · Tests 2 failed | 440 passed (442)`. The two failures are exactly the two new cases in `heldDataCreate-26845` ("on a writable base…" and "on a read-only base with a pair…"). Last round, the same mutation left 438/438 green.
  - Restore: the blob after restore equals HEAD's `da3b6c68301c`. `git diff HEAD` and `git status --porcelain` were both empty afterwards.
- **Check-runs at head (REST, `commits/1d782fb0…/check-runs`).** 55 runs: 40 `success`, 15 `skipped`, 0 failed, 0 pending. No commit status (`state: pending`, `total_count: 0`).
  - The required contexts are all green or skipped. Branch protection names `TypeScript Type Check`, `Build Core`, `Test Core` and `Dogfood Regression Gate`. The `main` ruleset also names `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` and `Live E2E UI`. Every one is `success` except `Build Core`, which is `skipped` (the PR fast set). `l1-face` and `pr-state` read all 15 skips as expected, 0 unexpected.
  - Other `success` runs: Test UI shards 1–9 and their planner, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Type Check · debt ledger, and the Lint / Type Check sub-gates.
- **Merge-tree and K.** `git merge-tree --write-tree` of origin/main `5d21d431ec1949d420d419bbbb9a6519ac52d276` and the head exits 0, clean, tree `c870591b`.
  - K = 18, counted first-parent from the merge base `a89a0123` (it was 6 at `ecbe854b` last round). `landing-k.mjs --pr 37383` CAN'T ANSWER: the last green Test Core run (45751739267) ran no shard or planner, so no `Affected-set diff base` was printed. 18 is the merge-base count, not a PRBASE reading.
  - One main commit touches a PR file: `ab913233` (#37368, dashboard New → design mode) adds an `AreaCreate` branch in `StudioMetadataArea.tsx` (`+11`, at `:326`), in a different hunk. It adds no `/studio/` literal, no pillar address and no bare surface mount. In the merged tree `c870591b`, `git grep` of every symbol this PR deletes finds only the kept qualifier keys and the comments recorded last round. The other 11 commits since `ecbe854b` touch no PR file.
- **Governed / tier.** `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 37383` exits 0: "0 of 69 path(s) hit the register", NOT governed, with 2,063 changed lines (+1007 / -1056), at most 3,000. That is Tier S.

All three read `declared · no · arm null` and `declared · none`, so they match.

### Notes

- N1 — K is 18, so main merges before the queue. Per the landing rule (K ≥ 15 ⇒ merge main, then a green re-run), the landing seat merges origin/main and waits for the re-run before arming. `merge-tree` is clean, and the one overlap (#37368, `StudioMetadataArea.tsx`) is in a separate hunk.
